title: Do LLM Tutors Actually Teach? A Process-Centered Synthesis of the Tutoring Loop
abstract: arXiv:2610.15692v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models can produce fluent tu- toring dialogue, but whether they actually help students learn remains unclear. We present a process-centered synthesis of LLM tutoring that follows the path from learner-state infer- ence to pedagogical action, tutor training, eval- uation, and student simulation. This view ex- poses a central gap: implementing a tutoring component does not establish that it works or that its outputs meaningfully affect later stages. A structured study-level audit shows that peda- gogical evaluation is common, while evidence becomes much thinner for learner-conditioned intervention, human learning gains, and espe- cially transfer or delayed retention. Human studies nevertheless provide a conditional posi- tive result: LLM tutors can improve learning, but benefits depend on pedagogical structure, learner engagement, and how learning is mea- sured. We argue that progress requires validat- ing the interfaces

translated_title: 大语言模型导师真的在教书吗？以过程为中心的辅导循环综述
translated_abstract: 大语言模型能够生成流畅的辅导对话，但它们是否真正帮助学生学习仍不明确。我们提出了一种以过程为中心的大语言模型辅导综述，沿着从学习者状态推断到教学行动、导师训练、评估以及学生模拟的路径展开。这一视角揭示了一个核心缺口：实现某个辅导组件并不能证明它有效，也不能证明其输出会对后续阶段产生实质性影响。一项结构化的研究层面审计表明，教学评估较为常见，而在学习者条件化干预、人类学习收益，尤其是知识迁移或延迟保持方面的证据则明显薄弱。然而，人类研究提供了一个条件性的积极结果：大语言模型导师可以改善学习，但其收益取决于教学结构、学习者参与度以及学习效果的衡量方式。我们认为，要取得进展，需要验证各环节之间的接口。
tldr: 本文通过对大语言模型辅导流程的以过程为中心的系统综述发现，尽管教学评估较普遍，但证明真实学习收益、尤其是知识迁移与延迟保持的证据薄弱，且模型辅导效果依赖于教学结构、学习者参与度和学习衡量方式。
en_tdlr: This process-centered synthesis of LLM tutoring reveals that while pedagogical evaluation is common, evidence for learner-conditioned intervention, human learning gains, and especially transfer or delayed retention remains thin, with LLM tutors' benefits conditional on pedagogical structure, learner engagement, and how learning is measured.
